leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure an Express application to handle multipart/form-data requests
Implement middleware for processing file uploads in an Express route
Construct a file upload endpoint that accepts and stores uploaded files
Apply validation to restrict file types and sizes during upload
Initialize a static file-serving mechanism to make uploaded files accessible
Integrate file upload functionality into a complete Express application workflow
Manipulate uploaded file metadata to generate unique filenames and paths
